working_definition: P15 'tail' of differentiating neurons attached to Tm3 (tSNE) and Tm3, TmY3 and TmY8 (UMAP); the authors' call is 'probably immature Tm3, Tmy3 and TmY8 neurons'.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Immature form of a transmedullary neuron (Konstantinides et al., 2022).

justification: Grouped call. Immature Tm3 (FBbt:00052329) is_a immature transmedullary neuron, and immature transmedullary Y neuron (FBbt:00053542, parent of immature TmY3 and TmY8) is_a immature transmedullary neuron, so it is the most specific common parent. Verification flagged because of the authors' 'probably' hedge.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Immature form of the transmedullary neuron Tm3 (Tm3a) (Konstantinides et al., 2022). It is a Notch ON hemilineage secondary neuron, born from a medulla forming neuroblast during the Erm/Ey temporal window (Konstantinides et al., 2022).

Immature form of the transmedullary Y neuron TmY3 (Konstantinides et al., 2022). It is a Notch ON hemilineage secondary neuron, born from a medulla forming neuroblast during the Erm/Ey temporal window (Konstantinides et al., 2022).

Immature form of the transmedullary Y neuron TmY8 (Konstantinides et al., 2022). It is a Notch ON hemilineage secondary neuron, born from a medulla forming neuroblast during the Erm/Ey temporal window (Konstantinides et al., 2022).

recommendation: Broad match to immature transmedullary neuron; members Tm3, TmY3, TmY8.
